reason: I check the seller's profile and reviews and how long they've been around, and this one has none and is brand new. Pay on collection helps, but I'd still be driving out to meet a stranger about something that keeps me safe on the road.
objection: Could they be cracked or bent? A photo or report is only the seller's word, and with no reviews I've got nobody else to back it up.
would_change_my_mind: A handful of real reviews from people who bought and fitted a set, or a seller history I can check, plus a mate or a wheel shop confirming the set is straight when I view it.
